content:
Eva: Nightly eval alert — QA prompt-set exact-match dropped from 98.7% -> 94.1% after model bump to v3.2.0 + tokenizer-merge.

ci-bot: nightly-evals | v3.2.0 | QA EM: 94.1% (-4.6pp); hallucination-score +0.12; avg_tokens +0.3

Mike: Can we narrow down whether this is weights, tokenizer, or quantization?

Lucas: Pulled a couple failing examples. Short repro below.

Lucas: Prompt:
```
Q: Who wrote "A Study in Scarlet"?
A:
```

Lucas: Behavior:
- v3.1.8 (prod): "Arthur Conan Doyle"
- v3.2.0 (new): sometimes returns "Conan" or "\u0120Doyle" or truncated fragments.

Ana: That smells like a tokenization/normalization regression. We merged some entries in the Vocab/merge table — possibly left a nonprinting marker in outputs.

Mike: Did token counts change for the same prompt?

Lucas: Yes. v3.1.8 tokenized len=9, v3.2.0 len=11. KV-cache shifts by +2 for prefix.

ci-bot: test-matrix queued: (weights v3.1.8 + tokenizer old), (weights v3.2.0 + tokenizer old), (weights v3.2.0 + tokenizer new)

Ana: Re-ran small matrix: float32 weights with new tokenizer -> fail. New weights with old tokenizer -> pass. Quantized vs float had no bearing.

Eva: So primary culprit is tokenizer change (merge/normalizer) causing token offsets to differ -> decoding heuristics (forced-eos, prefix stripping) misfire.

Lucas: Token diffs (simplified):
```
# v3.1.8 tokens: ["Q",":","Who", ...] (9 tokens)
# v3.2.0 tokens: ["Q",":","Who","\u0120wrote","\u0120\"A","Study","in","\"","\u0120Scarlet","?","\n"] (11 tokens)
```

Ana: The "\u0120"/\u0128 markers come from the new unicode normalizer change we merged — we accidentally preserved a spacing marker in the merge output.

Mike: Action plan: rollback tokenizer-merge in serving canary; run targeted nightly eval with (v3.2.0 weights + old tokenizer) to validate. I'll open the rollback PR and trigger a canary.

Ana: I'll prepare a patch that strips the stray marker in normalization + add unit tests covering these QA prompts.

Lucas: I'll produce an eval diff spreadsheet with failing indices and a small harness to compare tokenization outputs across tokenizer versions.

ci-bot: created issue #4923 "tokenizer-normalizer-marker" and enqueued canary job job-3761.

Eva: Owners & ETA: Mike (rollback/canary), Ana (patch/tests), Lucas (eval diffs). Expected canary + initial report in ~24h. Prioritize quick fix, we'll reopen if weights issue appears after tokenizer fix.

Mike: Adding a temporary guard in decode to ignore leading nonprinting markers to buy time during rollout.

Lucas: Also drafting a short migration note for downstream tokenizer consumers — will add to changelog.

Ana: Draft PR ready in ~2h.

Eva: Keep updates here. If anyone spots a weights-only failure after this, ping me directly.
